description: Saves a completed ad to the project's Meta Ads or Google Ads account as a paused draft: on Meta a paused campaign, ad set and ad with the 4:5 image; on Google a paused Demand Gen campaign with a square version and the brand's logo. Nothing is turned on and nothing spends; the user reviews it and turns it on in the ad platform. Each call creates a new draft campaign. It uses the headline, text, daily budget (null means 10 a day) and countries (null means the US) it is given, which the user should see and approve first. It returns the link to the draft. When the account isn't connected, is connected more than once, can't run ads yet, or has several ad accounts or Facebook Pages to pick from, or the ad has no link or logo, the call is refused with what to ask or tell the user. Changing a draft afterward: the meta-marketing-api or google-ads skill. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

adAccountId.description: The ad account's id when a result asked which one; null otherwise.

connectionId.description: The connection's id when a result said the ad platform is connected more than once; null otherwise.

countries.description: Where to show the ad; null means the US.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in the ad account's currency; null means 10. The draft stays paused, so this is a starting point the user changes before turning it on.

description.description: One line of ad text you write from the ad, 90 characters at most; Meta shows it as the post text.

destination.description: meta_ads saves the 4:5 ad as a paused Meta campaign, ad set and ad. google_ads saves a square version and the brand's logo as a paused Google Demand Gen campaign (YouTube, Discover, Gmail).

headline.description: A short headline you write from the ad, 30 characters at most (Google's limit).

linkUrl.description: The page people land on when they click the ad, as a full address with https://; null means the store website saved on the project's brand.

pageId.description: Meta only: the Facebook Page's id when a result asked which one; null otherwise.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_send_ad
title: Save an ad to Meta Ads or Google Ads
